support: A grayscale starter brand guide for humans and agents — filled example copy you customize.
headline: Start fresh or bring your brand in
body: Build from scratch with the Branding Questionnaire, or hand your agent a website, PDF, brand.md, design dump, or Figma file — we'll fold what you have into this guide. Clone the repo on GitHub (https://github.com/sethjenks/brand-guide) to get started.

sources.label: Branding Questionnaire (recommended)
sources.detail: Agent asks one-by-one, or send as a written questionnaire. Source: intake/brand-intake-questionnaire.md.
sources.prompt: This brand-guide kit is still a starter (intake pending). Run the Branding Questionnaire in intake/brand-intake-questionnaire.md: ask one question at a time, save answers to resources/transcripts/, set brand/setup.json intake to "complete", then rewrite brand.md (including Design system), examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json from the transcript. Run npm run compile from guide/. When done, set brand/setup.json status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

sources.label: Website URL
sources.detail: Marketing site, product page, or About page your agent can read. Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from my website. Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Follow intake/populate-from-source.md: read the URL I provide (marketing / product / About), then update brand.md (Strategy / Voice / Visual / Expressions / Design system), examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json — cite the URL in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile from guide/. Keep the guide section structure; keep grayscale unless the site specifies a palette. When done, set status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

Website URL:

sources.label: Brand guide PDF
sources.detail: An existing PDF or deck — extract structure, voice, and visual rules. Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from my brand guide PDF (or deck). Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Follow intake/populate-from-source.md: extract strategy, voice, and visual rules from the file I attach, then update brand.md (including Design system), examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json — cite the PDF in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile from guide/. Keep the guide section structure; keep grayscale unless the PDF specifies a palette. When done, set status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

Attach or path to PDF:

sources.label: brand.md
sources.detail: A brand constitution file (this repo’s format — Strategy / Voice / Visual + Design system). Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from an existing brand.md (or compatible constitution). Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Follow intake/populate-from-source.md: merge or replace this repo’s brand.md with my source (Strategy / Voice / Visual / Expressions / Design system), update examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json as needed, and cite the source in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile from guide/. When done, set status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

Source brand.md path or paste:

sources.label: Design dump / DESIGN.md
sources.detail: Stitch/MD3-style DESIGN.md with YAML colors/type/radius/spacing. Use npm run import:design, then finish Strategy/Voice per populate-from-source. Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from a design dump (DESIGN.md). Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Follow intake/populate-from-source.md: from guide/, run npm run import:design -- --print <path> (or --splice --yes to replace the Design system fence), then fill Strategy / Voice / Visual / Expressions from any prose in the dump without inventing pillars from token names. Write brand/coverage.json. Cite the dump in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile and npm run post-populate-check from guide/. When done, set status to "populated". Do not hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json.

DESIGN.md path:

sources.label: Figma
sources.detail: A figma.com/design URL — agent uses Figma MCP per intake/populate-from-source.md. Skips the questionnaire.
sources.prompt:
Populate this brand-guide kit from my Figma design file. Set brand/setup.json intake to "skipped". Follow intake/populate-from-source.md → Figma MCP protocol: parse fileKey/nodeId, then metadata → variables/styles → frame copy → assets; write into brand.md (never hand-edit brand.json or tokens.json). Update examples.md, rules.md, and brand/setup.json; cite the Figma URL in sources[] with kind "citation". Run npm run compile from guide/. Keep grayscale unless the file specifies a palette. When done, set status to "populated".

Figma design URL:

prompt: This brand-guide kit is still a starter (intake pending). Start with the Branding Questionnaire in intake/brand-intake-questionnaire.md: ask one question at a time, save answers to resources/transcripts/, set brand/setup.json intake to "complete", then rewrite brand.md (including Design system), examples.md, rules.md, and setup from the transcript. Run npm run compile from guide/. When done, set status to "populated". If I already have a URL / PDF / brand.md / DESIGN.md / Figma design URL, set intake to "skipped" and follow intake/populate-from-source.md instead — or copy the matching prompt from the Accepted sources cards above.
